source_semantics: sector.cpp CheckDoorTile includes DOORTILE23 (4391); P_ActivateSwitch sends wall lotag to G_OperateMasterSwitches and plays hitag sound.
actors.cpp MASTERSWITCH counts hitag in 30Hz ticks then arms same-sector SEENINE; SEENINE shares arming by hitag and counts lotag down by 3 per tick.
actors.cpp DETONATE sets matching SE13 t_data[2], starting expansion to the authored sector heights.
DEFS.CON DESTRUCT=327; USER.CON binds it to detruct2.voc. No Blood briefing speech has been substituted.

native_contract.explanation: Normal invisible sprites return from state 1 to rest state 0 after waitTime; Off-only reporting sends On to the listeners. NBlood triggers.cpp SetSpriteState and default OperateSprite.
native_contract.timing_approximation: 2.6667s MasterSwitch and 0.2778/0.5556/0.8333s fuses rounded to Blood tenths; collapse starts at the rounded first detonation. Source speech and intermediate SE13 travel are not reproduced exactly.
